training.optimizer: Unchanged registered AdamW parameter groups, losses, seeds and patient-prefix schedule.
training.initialization: Backbone seed; refinement seed+4100; continuation seed+7100. Fresh optimizer at each stage.
training.selection: Stage1/2 maximum validation AP earliest. Continuation includes epoch0, original arm-relative quality guard then minimum DDI. B1 includes epoch0 and maximum AP.
training.dynamic: Train monitor only; target .9*initial hardDDI; lambda0=1, lr20, clipped[0,10].
training.sharing: Graph-free main reuses original no_graph F/D; matched controls initialize at that F. All ablations refit graph-free heads on their exact original independent backbone.

analysis.continued_new: micro F1 for each history-union candidate partition; arithmetic mean.
analysis.baseline_bootstrap_scope: Patient-paired, average over three EviDrug seeds versus the one fixed existing baseline seed; conditional on those fitted models, not seed-paired baseline inference.

interventions.full: Medication identity/history and clinical associations; no graph representation branch; dynamic DDI retained.
interventions.no_history: Same graph-free head on the original independently trained history-free backbone.
interventions.no_memory: Same graph-free head on the original independently trained case-memory-free backbone.
interventions.no_set: Same graph-free head on the original independently trained set-block-free backbone.
interventions.no_clinical: Remove clinical associations from the graph-free model; same full backbone.
interventions.controls: Zero/fixed coefficients .05/.1/1 share each selected graph-free fusion checkpoint.

comparison_scope: Retrospective development evaluation; graph removal explicitly chosen by user after prior results. Existing baseline single-seed budgets retained.
